description.value: Cold Front Gelato is a locally owned, handcrafted gelato shop in downtown Nanaimo whose founders trained in Bologna, Italy to master traditional production methods. Each month they rotate new flavours built around Vancouver Island milk, cream, and locally sourced fruits, herbs, and artisan goods from named regional suppliers. Both classic dairy and fully dairy-free vegan gelato are available, along with milkshakes, affogato, and hot drinks, and pints can be taken to go.

address.value: 60 Commercial Street, Unit 306, Nanaimo, BC V9R 5G4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business as an active handmade gelato shop at 306-60 Commercial Street, Nanaimo. Phone '(250) 591-7719' and email match OSM exactly; the website's address 'Cold Front Gelato - Our Locations' lists '306- Commercial St Nanaimo, BC' consistent with OSM unit 306. Vegan and gluten-free labels appear explicitly on the gelato flavours page, and a 'take home a pint' offer confirms takeout; no bike parking, washroom, or water refill evidence appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags. A notable discrepancy exists between OSM opening hours (Thursday–Sunday only) and the website (Monday–Sunday), with the website treated as authoritative.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag (Th–Su only) conflicts with the website, which lists hours Monday through Sunday; the website is treated as authoritative but the OSM tag should be updated.
Bike parking, washrooms, and water refill are unconfirmed — in-person verification recommended before publishing those fields.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An established, locally owned food stop in central Nanaimo offering vegan and GF options and take-home pints — a practical and enjoyable mid-ride or post-ride destination for touring cyclists on Vancouver Island.
